title: Groundwater Contamination in Coastal Village
description: High salinity and industrial chemical runoff severely affecting drinking water wells across 3 coastal villages. Existing reverse osmosis units break down constantly due to particulate fouling.

aiAnalysis.summary: This problem requires Environmental Engineering and IoT sensor expertise due to severe salinity gradients and industrial contaminant traces. Nanofiltration with smart telemetry recommended.

title: Municipal Waste Segregation Failure & Landfill Spills
description: Urban solid waste collection lacks source-level automated classification. Organic and hazardous plastics mix, overwhelming secondary recycling centers and causing spontaneous landfill fires.

aiAnalysis.summary: Requires computer-vision enabled smart bins and edge classification nodes at transfer stations to enforce dynamic sorting and optimize truck dispatch logistics.

title: Hyper-Local Crop Pest Outbreak Early Warning System
description: Pink bollworm and fall armyworm outbreaks destroy up to 40% of cotton and maize yields in Vidarbha. Farmers receive pest alerts days too late after physical crop damage is already visible.

aiAnalysis.summary: Requires ultra-low-power LoRaWAN sensor nodes with micro-acoustic insect frequency detection and edge-inference models to alert farmers within 2 hours of swarm arrival.

title: Solar-Powered Cold Storage Micro-Hubs for Coastal Fisherfolk
description: Small-scale artisanal fishermen lose 30% of their daily catch value due to extreme harbor temperatures and lack of immediate ice refrigeration at landing piers.

aiAnalysis.summary: Phase-change material (PCM) battery-less thermal cooling unit powered directly by rooftop solar panels. Deployed and monitored via continuous cloud telemetry.

title: Low-Cost Point-of-Care Ultrasound Diagnostic Scanner for Tribal PHCs
description: Primary Health Centers in remote hilly tribal hamlets lack trained radiologists and ultrasound facilities, leading to delayed diagnoses of high-risk maternal pregnancies.

aiAnalysis.summary: Handheld sub-$400 piezoelectric probe connected via USB-C to standard tablets, running guided fetal biometric measurement algorithms for community nurses.
